primary_claim: Honesty-elicitation techniques -- especially pretrain-style next-token completion, few-shot prompting, and honesty fine-tuning -- substantially increase truthful responses from censored Chinese LLMs on politically sensitive topics and transfer to frontier open-weight models (DeepSeek-R1-0528, Qwen3.5-397B, MiniMax-M2.5); for lie detection, simply prompting the censored model to classify its own responses performs nearly as well as an uncensored-model upper bound.

effect.metric: honesty score (autorater factual accuracy/completeness) and lie-detection balanced accuracy
effect.value: next-token completion, few-shot prompting, and honesty fine-tuning are the most effective elicitation techniques, decreasing generated falsehoods; frontier open-weight models with baseline honesty scores below 30% show notable increases after applying the best techniques; self-classification lie detection performs near the uncensored-model upper bound

quote: Simply asking the model to classify its own responses works really well, almost as well as asking an uncensored model.
